title: TEHRAN - Oct 16, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian made remarks after returning to Iran from participation in the 17th Summit of the Conference of the Parties to the Convention on Biological Diversity (COP 17) hosted by Armenia.
text:
TEHRAN - Oct 16, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian made remarks after returning to Iran from participation in the 17th Summit of the Conference of the Parties to the Convention on Biological Diversity (COP 17) hosted by Armenia."

""

"------"

"SOT1, Masoud Pezeshkian, President of Iran (Farsi) (01:17 - 02:00): "The wars, conflicts, and actions that these great powers are actually carrying out are the main causes of the destruction of this ecosystem in which we live in. They claim to be proponents of civilization and human rights, yet they act against that very civilization and those human rights. In the wars they have instigated, they have caused the greatest damage to the environment, to the forests, the air, the land, the soil, and all types of nature in which we live. The actions they have taken are unforgivable.”"

"SOT2, Masoud Pezeshkian, President of Iran (Farsi) (00:00 - 00:38): "The destruction of this house we live in will no longer distinguish between Iranian, Arab, non-Arab, or American. Harm will come to everyone, and this very memory of the summit that took place, it was an important summit, we participated, just as you said, for the first time the President of Iran is participating in such a summit. We had two talks with the Prime Minister of Armenia himself regarding the interactions we had with each other, the work we needed to do; we talked again about having a strategic document together. It was decided that our experts would sit down and talk with each other.”"

""
"SOT3, Masoud Pezeshkian, President of Iran (Farsi) (00:00 - 00:38): "The second team has again, meaning once more, accepted that the team must leave. This is one aspect; regarding the Red Cross field, I personally pursued this and had a meeting with the Red Cross officials in Tehran. I met with the new head of the Red Cross office in Tehran, Ms. Maristella Chao, who agreed to follow up on the matter more seriously and accepted that this is a serious issue on our behalf that must be resolved.”"

""
"SOT4, Masoud Pezeshkian, President of Iran (Farsi) (00:00 - 00:38): "We had good talks with Tajikistan’s Emomali Rahmon, and all in all, considering what happened and the contacts that were established, I think it is beneficial both for the environment we live in and for the relations we should have with one another in a healthy way.”
